summary: Test cycles claude->codex via the real pilot UI and asserts the rendered model list flips from claude's exact vocabulary (fable/opus/sonnet) to codex's (gpt-5.6-sol/terra/luna) and the effort list from empty to codex's low/medium/high/xhigh, matching the real harness registry — a stale, missing, or wrong-harness refresh of either vocabulary fails an exact-list assertion.
